Violence Erupts After Youth's Death, Leading to Arrests

A dispute over a rap song escalated into violence, resulting in a youth being attacked with knives and stones, and one death. In a separate incident, a road accident involving a youth led to a blockade and stone-pelting, injuring several police personnel. Authorities have made multiple arrests in connection with the first incident.
